title: BEML Recruitment 2026 – Apprentices (Graduate Technical, Graduate General, Diploma, ITI/Trade) Posts
shortInfo: BEML has announced notification for Apprentices (Graduate Technical, Graduate General, Diploma, ITI/Trade) posts. Required qualification: BE/B.Tech, Diploma, Graduation, ITI. Last date to apply: 08-09-26.
howToApply: Register on NAPS (https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) for ITI trades OR on NATS (https://nats.education.gov.in/) for Degree/Diploma in Engineering as a candidate/student and complete/update your profile by uploading all required documents.
Obtain your NAPS/NATS Registration/Enrolment Number.
Visit the official BEML recruitment website: https://recruitment.bemlindia.in → Apprentices → Login/Registration.

Fill in the online application form with accurate details including NAPS/NATS enrolment number, educational qualifications, Aadhaar-seeded DBT-enabled bank account details, and upload required documents.
Submit the application before 23:00 Hrs on 08.09.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
Note: There is no application fee, written examination, or interview process.

howToApply: Applications will be received online only through the LPSC Online Recruitment Portal.
The online Recruitment Portal will be available from 1400 hrs on 18.08.2026 to 1400 hrs on 04.09.2026.
Candidates registered under National Career Service (NCS) portal and fulfilling eligibility conditions may visit LPSC website and follow the same application procedure.
Upload photograph in JPG/JPEG format (max 40 KB, resolution 95-100 pixels, white/light background, face clearly visible).
Upload certificates/mark sheets and experience certificates pertaining to prescribed essential qualifications.
Candidates applying for posts reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PWBD/Ex-servicemen must upload relevant certificates.
Pay application fee online: Rs. 750/- for Post Nos. 813 & 814; Rs. 500/- for Post Nos. 802, 815, 816 & 817.
Fee payment can be made immediately after submitting the application or up to 1400 hrs on 07.09.2026 via the ‘Make Payment’ option on the portal.
Provide correct bank account details (Name, Account No., IFSC Code) for fee refund.
Upon successful registration, an online registration number will be provided — note and keep it safe. No documents need to be sent to LPSC after online registration.
In case of duplicate/multiple applications, the latest application against which fee has been received within the last date will be considered.

title: UCSL Recruitment 2026 – Office Assistant, Draftsman (Mechanical), Draftsman (Electrical), Technician (Electrical), Store Keeper Posts
shortInfo: UCSL has announced notification for Office Assistant, Draftsman (Mechanical), Draftsman (Electrical), Technician (Electrical), Store Keeper posts. Required qualification: Bachelor's Degree, Diploma, ITI. Last date to apply: 01-09-26.
howToApply: Read the User Manual and FAQ published on www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → UCSL, Malpe) or www.udupicsl.com (Career page) before applying.
Complete One-time Registration in the SAP Online portal.
Submit the online application against the applicable post from 11 August 2026 to 01 September 2026.
Upload all required certificates: proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste, disability, and a recent passport-size colour photograph.
Pay the application fee of ₹300/- (non-refundable) online via Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/Wallets/UPI (SC/ST/PwBD candidates are exempted).
Do not submit more than one application. Application once submitted is final.
Retain a soft copy/printout of the online application with the unique registration number for future reference.
Do not send printouts or certificates by post to UCSL.

title: CSL Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentices (Category I), Technician (Diploma) Apprentices (Category II) Posts
shortInfo: CSL has announced notification for Graduate Apprentices (Category I), Technician (Diploma) Apprentices (Category II) posts. Required qualification: Degree in Engineering/Technology, Diploma in Engineering/Technology. Last date to apply: 01-09-26.
howToApply: Visit the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in.

If already registered on old portal (portal.mhrdnats.gov.in): Activate your account on the new portal using the ‘Forgot Password’ option at the student login page. Login and complete the application form ensuring all details are correct. Then search for ‘COCHIN SHIPYARD LIMITED’ under ‘Apply against advertised vacancies’ and click Apply.

If not registered on old portal: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click ‘Student’, then ‘Student Register’, complete the application form, and note the unique Enrolment Number generated. Then login, search for ‘COCHIN SHIPYARD LIMITED’ under ‘Apply against advertised vacancies’, and click Apply.
Ensure all marks and details are entered correctly before submission.
For issues/queries related to NATS portal, contact Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT), Southern Region, Chennai via email: studentquery@boatsrp.com.
Online application window: 12.08.2026 to 01.09.2026.

howToApply: Visit the NATS 2.0 portal at https://nats.education.gov.in.
